analysis.summary: Management stated that revenue from operations for H1 FY27 increased by 183.10% to reach 19,596.41 lakhs, while EBITDA grew by 121.31% to 1,194.68 lakhs. Profit After Tax witnessed a growth of 203.92% to reach 675.73 lakhs compared to H1 FY26. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Morbi, Gujarat with an installed capacity of 72 lakhs p.a. for clocks and 240 lakhs p.a. for clock movements.

guidance.claim: Management has given full-year growth guidance of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: Q1 FY’27 revenue grew by 75.6% on a year-on-year basis, you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the 1st Quarter reflects deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a little bit of impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand has been affected by logistic problems due to the war scenario.
demand_outlook.quote: Export demand has been affected. Our main export market is Iraq. We have a lot of orders from Iraq. Goods are also ready. But we are on hold due to logistic problems.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the margin is fluctuating a bit due to daily raw material price increases and decreases.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs have increased and impacted margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, raw material cost has increased.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization is running at 60% to 70%.
The company has a good order book and a lot of corporate orders.
orders_capacity.quote: We also have a lot of corporate orders. We have a good order book.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing or funding for now.
Debtors reduced from Rs. 10 crore in 2024-25 to Rs. 6.73 crores in 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores. Debtors have reduced.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that exports have faced a negative impact due to an increase in prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues and war in geographies increased raw material prices and freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, sir, because market’s competition and revenue has increased, but margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to sustain 25% to 30% growth for the full year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
